faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: How AniKitty works, what features need an account, and what data the site collects. Last reviewed for v0.7.6.
faq.contactDesc: Join the Discord community or open an issue on GitHub. For account-specific requests (deletion, privacy), contact moderators there.

basics.whatIsA: AniKitty is a free anime streaming site with no subscription paywall. Browse the catalog, watch episodes in sub or dub where available, rate and review titles, and join community features when signed in. We're sorry, but site ads help afford running costs (~€100/month for servers and streaming). They never run inside the video player or on profile pages. Signed-in users can turn them off in Settings → General. AniKitty does not host video files — streams are resolved through third-party sources via KittyAPI.
basics.accountA: No — you can browse and watch without signing in. An account unlocks your watchlist, synced progress across devices, watch history, episode comments, forum posts, live chat, friends, public profiles, levels and achievements, Kittycoins, optional AniList import, reviews, and security options like 2FA and passkeys. Sign up from the Log in button in the navbar.
basics.freeA: Yes. There is no paid tier. The video player and profile pages stay ad-free. We're sorry about site ads elsewhere — they help afford the ~€100/month running cost. Signed-in users can disable them in Settings → General. Optional Ko-fi tips grant the donator role as a thank-you.

watching.streamingA: When you open an episode, the player requests stream URLs through AniKitty's backend, which talks to KittyAPI. Switch between sub/dub and providers on the watch page where available. If a dub stream is missing, the player automatically falls back to sub on the same server. If playback fails, it can failover to another server. Progress saves to your account when logged in.
watching.continueA: When signed in, the home page and your profile show titles you started recently so you can jump back in. Progress is stored in the database and cached locally in your browser for faster resume. You can also open the full Watch History page from the account menu.
watching.recommendationsA: When signed in with some watch history, the home page shows a "Recommended for you" row based on related titles from the catalog. New accounts see a prompt to start watching first.
watching.recentlyViewedQ: What is the Recently viewed row?
watching.recentlyViewedA: The home page keeps a local list of anime you opened recently so you can jump back to something you were browsing. It is stored only in your browser and is separate from Continue Watching.
watching.voiceActorsQ: Can I look up voice actors?
watching.voiceActorsA: Yes. Open any anime and use the Voice Actors tab, or click a voice actor to open their page with their full filmography. You can also search voice actors by name and filter by language from the Voice Actors page in the footer.
watching.anilistQ: Can I sync my list from AniList?
watching.anilistA: Yes. In Settings → Connections, connect AniList via OAuth and import your library into your AniKitty watchlist. MyAnimeList account sign-in was removed — use AniList for list sync. Anime pages still show MyAnimeList metadata (score, rank, popularity, etc.) for reference.
watching.subtitlesA: The player loads subtitle tracks when available. Subtitles are shown in SUB mode and hidden in DUB mode. Customize appearance and timing offset in Settings → Subtitles. The Subtitle Library lists tracks cached when you watch episodes — use refresh on that page to manually fetch more.
watching.scheduleA: Schedule shows what is airing this week in your local timezone. Trending highlights popular and upcoming titles from the catalog feed.

accountSection.createQ: How do I create an account?
accountSection.createA: Click Log in in the navbar, switch to Sign up, and enter a username (3–25 letters, numbers, or underscores), email, and password (8+ characters). Your password is hashed before storage. After signing in you can add a passkey under Settings → Security for faster sign-in with Face ID, Touch ID, or Windows Hello.
accountSection.profileQ: What is on my public profile?
accountSection.profileA: Others can see your avatar, banner, bio, role and level badges, achievements, watchlist lists, watch-activity heatmap, and recent episode comments — unless you turn on Ninja mode in Settings → Privacy. Your profile also shows follower counts, a library breakdown, and friend actions when viewing someone else.
accountSection.ninjaA: Ninja mode hides your profile, watchlist, activity, and comments from everyone except you. Your username can still appear in live chat, forum posts, and episode comments.
accountSection.levelsQ: How do levels and XP work?
accountSection.levelsA: XP comes from watching episodes and posting episode comments. Levels unlock display tiers on your profile, chat, and forum. Daily login streaks grant bonus Kittycoins every 7 days.
accountSection.achievementsA: Achievements are badges you unlock for milestones like episodes watched, comments posted, reviews written, leveling up, and login streaks. They appear on your profile sidebar with progress bars for locked ones.
accountSection.passkeysA: Optional passkeys let you sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key instead of typing your password. Add or remove them under Settings → Security. Passkeys are stored on your device (or synced by your password manager when supported).
accountSection.twoFactorA: Optional TOTP can be enabled under Settings → Security. When enabled, login requires your password plus a 6-digit code from an authenticator app.
accountSection.sessionsA: Settings → Security lists devices where you are logged in. You can revoke individual sessions or log out everywhere.

community.chatA: Live chat is real-time and requires an account. Messages auto-delete after a short time. You can edit or delete your own messages, search GIFs inline, and links in messages are clickable.
community.forumA: The forum is for longer discussions — threads, replies, polls, and staff announcements. Content is stored until moderators remove it.
community.commentsA: On the watch page you can leave text and optional GIF comments per episode when signed in. Comments support @mentions, clickable timestamps that jump the player, and ||inline spoilers||. Moderators can pin a comment. Sort by New, Best, Top, or Old.
community.followA: Yes. Open someone's profile and tap Follow. You get a notification when someone follows you, and each profile shows follower and following counts you can tap to see the full lists.
community.friendsA: Following is one-way — you see their public activity. Friends are mutual: send a request from their profile, accept or decline incoming requests, and unfriend anytime. Both users get notified when you become friends.
community.notificationsA: The bell in the navbar shows unread mentions, replies, new followers, friend requests, and direct messages. Mark everything read from the dropdown, and choose which types you receive in Settings → Notifications.
community.blockA: Yes. Use the Block button on a user's profile. Blocking hides their comments from you and stops them from messaging or following you. Manage your blocked list in Settings → Privacy.
community.reportQ: How do I report a comment?
community.reportA: Tap the flag icon on any comment to send it to moderators. Reports go into a moderation queue where staff can resolve or dismiss them.
community.w2gA: Watch Together lets a host create a room code so friends sync the same episode in real time.
community.onlineQ: What does the online counter mean?
community.onlineA: The online badge counts browser sessions that sent a heartbeat recently — everyone browsing or watching, not a list of logged-in usernames.

privacy.dataQ: What data does AniKitty store about me?
privacy.dataA: Account info (username, email, password hash, profile customization), watch data (watchlist, progress, history), community content (chat, forum, comments, messages), social graph (follows, friends, blocks), session records, achievements, Kittycoin balance, and preferences like Ninja mode and ad settings.
privacy.browserQ: What is stored only in my browser?
privacy.browserA: Session cookie, player and UI settings, progress cache, recently viewed anime, online heartbeat ID, level stats cache, and subtitle appearance preferences.
privacy.thirdPartyA: Google Analytics for page views, KittyAPI for streams, AniList if you connect it, optional Anisurge if you link an account, site ads to help afford running costs, and external Discord/GitHub/Ko-fi links.
privacy.notDoA: AniKitty does not sell your personal data and does not host video files on its servers. The video player and profile pages stay ad-free.
privacy.deleteQ: How can I delete my data?
privacy.deleteA: Go to Settings → Privacy → Account deletion to request permanent removal. You can also revoke sessions, disconnect AniList, and manage blocked users before deleting.
privacy.cookiesA: Sign-in uses an HttpOnly session cookie. Google Analytics may set its own cookies. The site enforces HTTPS in production.

support.adsA: We're sorry, but running AniKitty costs about €100 per month — servers, streaming, and the database. Site ads are how we afford to keep everything free. They never run inside the video player or on profile pages.
support.disableA: Yes. Sign in and go to Settings → General to disable site ads — synced on every device. No donation required.
support.kofiA: No. The site is free for everyone whether you donate or not. Ko-fi tips are optional, grant the donator badge as a thank-you, and help cover costs — but they are not required to use AniKitty or to hide ads.

security.passwordA: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Login issues a signed JWT in an HttpOnly session cookie. Passkeys use the WebAuthn standard and never send your biometric data to our servers.
security.httpsA: Yes — use the site over HTTPS. HTTP requests redirect to HTTPS in production.
security.rateLimitA: Sensitive actions (sign-up, login, posting, reporting) are rate-limited by IP and/or user ID to reduce abuse.
security.moderationA: Admins and moderators can manage forum content, live chat, comment reports, and user roles. Staff announcements appear in the forum.

rules.title: Comment community rules
rules.intro: Before you post, please read and follow these rules. They keep discussions fun and safe for everyone.
rules.agreeLabel: I have read and agree to follow these community rules.

items.spoilers: Mark spoilers with the Spoiler button. Don't reveal plot twists, endings, or future events without tagging them.
items.respect: Be respectful. Harassment, hate speech, slurs, and personal attacks are not allowed.
items.nsfw: No NSFW content — sexual, overly graphic, or inappropriate material is not allowed in comments or GIFs.
items.spam: No spam, ads, scam links, or off-topic flooding. Keep comments about the anime and episode.
items.moderation: Moderators may remove comments or restrict accounts that break these rules.

donate.title: Support AniKitty
donate.subtitle: Optional Ko-fi tips help afford the ~€100/month running cost. Donate €4 with your @username for one month as a donator.
donate.body: AniKitty is free for everyone. We're sorry about the ads — they exist because servers and streaming cost about €100 every month, and tips alone do not cover it. If you enjoy watching here, an optional Ko-fi donation helps directly. Donations grant the donator badge — not ad removal. Signed-in users can turn ads off in Settings.
donate.sorryBody: Nobody here likes them. But running AniKitty — servers, streaming, database, and bandwidth — costs about €100 every month. Site ads are the only way we can keep the site free for everyone right now. They never run inside the video player. Sign in and open Settings → General to turn them off anytime. Ko-fi tips help too, but donating is never required.
donate.badgePreviewDesc: The donator role shows a pink heart badge on your profile, comments, and forum posts for as long as your support is active.
donate.adsNote: Donating does not remove ads — signed-in users can disable them in Settings. We're sorry they exist; they help us afford keeping the site online.
donate.donationDesc: Include your AniKitty @username in the Ko-fi message to get the donator role — e.g. €4 → 30 days, €8 → 60 days, €2 → 15 days.
donate.claimSignIn: Sign in to activate your donator role.
donate.claimSuccess: Donator role activated for {days} days — thank you for supporting AniKitty!
donate.claimNotFound: No matching Ko-fi donation found yet. Include your @username in the Ko-fi message, wait a minute, then try again or DM @fampep.
donate.claimFeedUnavailable: Auto-activation is temporarily unavailable — DM @fampep and we will help manually.
donate.claimAmountTooSmall: That donation is too small to activate the donator role.
donate.claimFailed: Could not activate donator access. Try again or DM @fampep.

steps.pay: Donate any amount on Ko-fi. Put {username} in the Ko-fi message field so we can match your tip.
steps.dm: Send @{username} a DM containing {mention} (your own AniKitty username) — or tap Activate donator on this page.
steps.auto: We read recent Ko-fi donations and grant donator time based on the amount you sent.
steps.help: Something wrong? DM @{username} and we will sort it out manually.

donate.activeDonator: You have the donator role on your profile — thank you for supporting AniKitty!
donate.activeDonatorUntil: Your donator role is active until {date} — thank you for supporting AniKitty!
donate.faqDonatorA: Ko-fi tips with your AniKitty @username in the message grant the donator role for a period based on the amount (€4 ≈ 30 days). You get a pink heart badge on your profile and comments. Donating does not remove ads — signed-in users can turn them off in Settings.
donate.faqBannerQ: Why are there ads if the site is free?
donate.faqBannerA: We're sorry, but AniKitty costs about €100/month to run. Site ads help us afford servers and streaming so we do not have to charge anyone. They never run inside the player. Sign in and disable them in Settings → General if you prefer.
donate.faqKoFiA: Donate on Ko-fi (ko-fi.com/fampep) with your @username in the message, then tap Activate donator on this page or DM @fampep. We match recent donations automatically when possible.
donate.faqVoluntaryA: No. AniKitty stays completely free whether you donate or not. Tips are optional and help cover the running costs ads alone cannot always cover.

perks.donatorBadgeDesc: €4 on Ko-fi grants the donator role with a pink heart badge on your profile and comments.
perks.uptimeDesc: Your support helps pay for the servers that power playback — alongside the ads we are sorry we have to show.
perks.communityDesc: Run by enthusiasts who want a better free anime site.
